No, promo codes can't be added after ordering—you'd need to place a new order to use a different code. 

However, as a Leafy Plus member, you're getting 10% member pricing on eligible items anyway. Here's the important part: **only one promo code per order is allowed**, and if your Plus discount is better than the promo code, it applies automatically instead. Since your 15% code is better than the 10% Plus discount, that's what you're getting—so you can't stack a second code on top.

If you'd like to explore other options, I'm happy to escalate this to a Support Lead.
